newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Suharto says he is in good health.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Suharto says he is in good health.

text.p: Indonesian President Suharto has told villagers in Central Java he is healthy even though he is 75 years old, the official Antara news agency reported on Friday.
"I am in good health," Suharto was quoted as saying during a visit on Thursday to Wuroyantoro village.
Earlier this month financial markets gyrated on rumours that Suharto's health was failing. Officials dismissed the rumours.
On Friday, Suharto took his usual position in the front row of worshippers at Jakarta's main Istiqal mosque to mark the Islamic feast day of Eid al-Adha.
The ceremony, broadcast live on television, showed Suharto conducting the prayer ritual with thousands of other worshippers without any apparent problems.
Last year, his absence from the early morning prayer service was the first public sign that his wife, Tien, had died earlier that morning.
After attending the prayers with vice-president Try Sutrisno on Friday, the two leaders donated a cow each to be slaughtered and divided up for the poor as part of the annual ritual.
